div.head: Rect 14
div.ab: Be sceap hyrdan . Sceaphyrdes riht is þæt he hæbbe twelf nihta ðingan to middanwintra . 7. i. lamb of geares geogeðe . 7 i belflys . 7 his heorde meolc . vii . niht æfter emnihtes dæge 7 blede fulle hweges oððe syringe ealne sumor .

Concerning the shepherd The shepherd’s right is that he has twelve night’s [worth of] dung at mid-winter, and one lamb from the year’s young, and the fleece of one bell-wether [the lead ram of the flock], and his flock’s milk [for] seven nights after the equinox, and a bowl full of whey or sour milk [for the] entire summer.

[14] Be sceaphyrdan. Sceaphyrdes riht is, þæt he hæbbe twelf nihta [d]ingan to Middanwintra 7 I lamb of geares geogeðe 7 I belflys 7 his heorde meolc VII niht æfter emnihtes dæge 7 blede fulle hweges oððe syringe ealne sumor.
